text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Huh~? That's weird. I'm positive I heard 
someone calling for me~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Hah! Could that have been the Three 
Goddesses just now?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't tell me... Did you finally 
notice my genius?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Do I get a reward or something~~!?
